principle: Few primary brains; many skills/modules; one accountable owner per decision/action.

primary_brains.role: Decide whether commerce is real and feasible
Choose what each shopper sees and how interactions behave
Turn approved intent into reliable execution
Measure, evaluate, protect, learn and rollback

shared_control_planes.purpose: One contract for every interactive action across every page and device.
One session/account/permission truth across pages, tabs and guest-to-account merge.
One visual and accessibility state vocabulary.
Canonical workflow graph, run state, handoffs, retries and Owner Gate routing. n8n or any other engine executes beneath this plane.
Allowlisted boundary for external/internal tools; secrets stay outside workflow definitions and material actions remain gated.
Durable run/evidence lineage for mission_id, workflow_id, run_id, correlation_id, outcomes and rollback learning.
One canonical schedule registry. Triggers runs only; never grants material action permission.
Canonical truth, policy, decision, calibration, routing, multi-judge, simulation and decision-ledger protocol shared across existing Brains; never a Primary Brain.

rules: F50 never self-approves; material F50 ideas return to F35 Kill Test.
F50 output returns to F35 as a review_route, never as a dependency cycle.
F60T attention alone is not purchase intent.
No commercial activation before Commerce Truth passes.
No external spend/publish/price/payment/supplier/production action without Owner Gate.
No UI action may have more than one state owner.
No button is complete without pending, success, error, disabled and retry/rollback semantics where applicable.
Guest state must define merge behavior on sign-in.
All material actions emit normalized telemetry with correlation_id.
A brain changing lifecycle mode requires evidence and an explicit recorded decision; code presence alone never activates it.
Automation engines such as n8n are execution adapters only; they never become decision owners or bypass BOOM Orchestrator.
Every automated run must carry mission_id, workflow_id, run_id and correlation_id.
Every side effect requires idempotency, timeout, bounded retry and a failure route.
Targets such as 17 departments × 1,000 products are planning goals; only verified catalog evidence may mark shelf readiness.
Legacy Managers have no decision authority after canonical mapping; boom-agent-registry.json defines their new Agent/Module/Adapter role.
A skill filename containing 'brain' never creates a Primary Brain; boom-brain-registry.json is the sole Primary Brain authority.
Department growth changes taxonomy data/modules, not the number of Brains or Agents.
BDIF is shared decision infrastructure, never a ninth Primary Brain.

lifecycle_modes.SHADOW: Runs and records recommendations but cannot change user/system behavior.
lifecycle_modes.ACTIVE: May drive internal behavior within its contract.
lifecycle_modes.GATED: May prepare actions but requires Owner Gate for external/material execution.
lifecycle_modes.DEPRECATED: Kept only for migration/history; no new ownership.
